nodes.name: Web VP - Pick Order Details
nodes.description: Web Visual Picking page listing the materials of one pick order with available/pick quantities, storage bins and destination wagons. Frontend component mapping is manual in the POC.

metadata.frontend: Web VP (TypeScript); component/service scan is a P1 input

nodes.name: GET /cwp/v1/picking/pickOrder
nodes.description: EBBA API endpoint returning CWPPickOrderModel[] for the authenticated user's facility and pick group.

nodes.name: GetStorageBin
nodes.description: Resolves storage bins for a destination wagon (by facility and pick group) through the site-configured procedure: PickingOptions.StorageBinProcedure, dbo.AP_Pick_GetPutStorageBin at this site.

metadata.resolved: 2026-09-17 (P1 input: procedure name confirmed, see source/config/site-settings.json)

nodes.name: AP_Pick_GetPutStorageBin
nodes.description: Storage bins for a destination wagon (Facility, PickGroupId), mapped onto CWPStorageBin. Named by the site configuration PickingOptions.StorageBinProcedure; its definition has not been provided yet, so where Location comes from inside the procedure is not known.

metadata.reason: Pending: named by site configuration (PickingOptions.StorageBinProcedure, provided 2026-09-17); the procedure definition has not been provided yet.

nodes.name: GetMultiPickOrderRows
nodes.description: Multi pick order flow; out of scope for the first iteration.

metadata.reason: Pending: multi pick order flow is out of scope for the first iteration.

nodes.name: AF_Pick_GetAvailableQuantity
nodes.description: WMS available quantity for a product at a warehouse location. Returns 1000 for LVP delivery; otherwise sums INVENTORY2 rows with InventoryStatus = 1 (QuantityAllocated for ECU products and LVS_MPA / SLFR_MPA / LVS_LINE / SLFR_LINE delivery methods, QuantityOnHand otherwise), adding the parent location when Pick_UseParentLocation = 1 and skipping child containers (ChildContainerCalssID).

nodes.name: AF_GetSystemParameterValueint
nodes.description: Reads one system parameter as INT (typed variant of AF_GetSystemParameterValue). The scanner maps every call to the SystemParameter node, so the definition is not needed for lineage.

metadata.reason: Pending: helper reader; not requested because parameter reads are resolved by name.

nodes.name: AF_GetSystemParameterValueListString
nodes.description: Table-valued reader returning one system parameter as a list of strings. The scanner maps every call to the SystemParameter node, so the definition is not needed for lineage.

metadata.reason: Pending: helper reader; not requested because parameter reads are resolved by name.

nodes.name: WMS_Enabled
nodes.description: 1 = warehouse management enabled: AvailableQuantity comes from AF_Pick_GetAvailableQuantity. 0 = legacy estimate SUM(Quantity) * 10.

nodes.name: PickOrder_Type
nodes.description: Filters the pick print queue rows considered by the pick order procedures.

nodes.name: PickDocumentClassForProductImage
nodes.description: Document class whose document URL is shown as the material image.

nodes.name: ChildContainerCalssID
nodes.description: Container class used to select child containers when listing inventory locations and to exclude them from the WMS available quantity (name kept as spelled in production).

nodes.name: Pick_UseParentLocation
nodes.description: 1 = AF_Pick_GetAvailableQuantity also counts the inventory of the parent warehouse location (WAREHOUSE_LOCATION_RELATION). 0 = only the requested location.

nodes.name: WL_Description_Replacement
nodes.description: 1 = show the translated warehouse location description instead of the raw Location code in StorageBin.

edges.evidenceRef: Web VP pickOrder service (manual mapping, see design doc §2)
